csv_scope_of_work: FXSB 26-7337 Repair Replace Hangar Roof B11551. title: Design-Build for Hangar Roof Repair and Replacement - B11551
short_description: Design-build tender for hangar roof replacement and associated roofing component renewals.
project_scope: Repair and replacement of the roof of Hangar B11551. The project removes the existing built-up roof from the barrel-shaped center roof section and three lower lean-to roof sections down to the existing structural decking. A new 3-ply SBS-modified built-up roof assembly with granular cap sheet is to be installed on the barrel roof section, and the three lower lean-to sections are to receive new 90-mil EPDM roof assemblies. All roofing assemblies are fully adhered. The works also include replacement of roof drains, flashings, vent pipe flashing, cover board, insulation, vapor barrier, cant strips, metal copings, and trim.
services: Design-build services for roof rehabilitation and replacement, including refurbishment, civil engineering, structural engineering, and construction/project management.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roof repair and replacement project for an existing hangar, not a long-span new roof or architecturally demanding special structure.
- Scope is dominated by roofing rehabilitation and construction execution rather than advanced structural design.
- Although design-build and structural engineering are mentioned, no significant structural complexity, span information, or innovative lightweight concept is described.
- Transportation/air force hangar context is adjacent to sbp interests, but this specific tender is mainly envelope refurbishment.
- Award appears to be a small business set-aside with a 100% goal, reducing strategic fit.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated in the source. The notice only provides a total construction cost of 19.0 million USD for a design-build roof rehabilitation project.
references_qualifications: Design-build tender; disciplines requested include rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, construction/project management, and structural engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
award_criteria: Goal: 100%. Small Business Set-aside. No further weighted award criteria are stated in the source.
